messages.goals.help.title: Goals
messages.goals.help.what: Track an outcome with acceptance requirements, dependencies, concerns, and decisions across list, graph, and board views until closure.
messages.goals.help.example-1: Create a goal with a clear outcome and acceptance criteria, then link prerequisite goals
messages.goals.help.example-2: Log concerns, verify evidence item by item, and close the goal once satisfied
messages.goals.help.scope: Goal records stay in this project’s local database; removing the plugin from a project keeps its data intact if you re-enable it later.
messages.goals.help.advanced: List, graph, and board show the exact same records; finished or canceled goals can be archived out of daily focus without losing history.
